environment.commitRole: source commit used for the packaged extension build; collector and evidence commit may be later
environment.profile: unique disposable /private/tmp directory; removed after run
environment.definition: Warm: fresh LeetCode tab in the same browser and worker. Cold: full browser restart with the same persisted disposable profile, then a fresh tab. Page marks and measures use their isolated-context clock; worker measures use the worker clock. Fixture restore and known-slug setup are untimed.

startup.workerAttribution: pending: worker performance entries have no request identity; per-open worker durations and percentiles are unavailable

limitations.worker: Worker measures have fixed stage names but no page-open or request identifier. A read window may contain duplicate or delayed work, so worker durations remain unattributed.
limitations.rendererTrace: Chrome toplevel tasks require extension and renderer attribution. All-process >50 ms counts alone do not establish either.
limitations.traceOverhead: The first warm and first cold opening include trace collection overhead.

unattributedWorker.note: Observed in a read window after each tab; entries may include delayed work from another opening. These durations are not per-open samples and have no percentiles.

warm.attributionNote: Task candidates cover all traced processes. CogniPace attribution requires an extension URL in the task arguments; absence of one does not prove no extension long task. Raw trace discarded.

cold.attributionNote: Task candidates cover all traced processes. CogniPace attribution requires an extension URL in the task arguments; absence of one does not prove no extension long task. Raw trace discarded.

submit.reason: Disposable profile has no authenticated LeetCode session; real Submit and disabled-extension comparison were not sampled. No code was submitted.
